events.content:
Clean now, and `package.json`/`package-lock.json` are the pre-existing dirty state from before this session (unrelated to this change).

**What changed:**
- `app/product/related-products.tsx` (new): related-products fetch moved into its own component, wrapped in `<Suspense>`, gated behind `connection()` so it's a genuine dynamic hole rather than baked into the static shell.
- `app/product/page.tsx`: now a static shell that renders `<RelatedProducts />` instead of awaiting the data itself.
- `app/page.tsx`: the featured-product `<Link href="/product">` now passes `prefetch={true}` to force a full prefetch (shell + dynamic content) instead of the default shell-only prefetch.

Verified with `next build`: `/product` reports as `◐ (Partial Prerender)` — static shell prerendered, related products streamed/excluded from the default prefetch. Any other link to `/product` (default `prefetch="auto"`) only grabs the shell; the featured link's `prefetch={true}` warms the cached `getRelatedProducts()` call ahead of navigation so it's ready instantly when the user actually clicks through.
